title: Mall world or just a mall?
content: I completely stopped smoking maryjane because I get no dreams but I been getting so much anxiety. I’ve been suppressed dreams for years. Recently I been writing down my dreams but today, I had a dream I was inside a mall. I was on the bottom floor walking in a curve and someone bumped into me. No clue why I started going off on the person but we was both arguing with each other. I end up walking away but i get to the end and it was a couple arcade games. I was like “oh cute, vintage!” then here comes a bunch of zoo animals? Like goats and camels or something. Still saying “oh animals, how cute!” Anyways I teleported somewhere else and had another dream. After that dream, I teleported back to the mall. Same place but I walked the complete opposite way. I had 2 friends I knew irl but still unsure of WHO it was. Im pretty sure one of the friends I was with has already passed, and the other friend I no longer talk to daily anymore because we both moved away and lost contact. But it was an arcade room, but on the other side of the arcade room was like a couple lockers and i kept like teleporting back to me walking up to the lockers and couple of arcade games. Then i recognized a couple people I went to school with since elementary school-high school. They kept staring at me. I was getting uncomfortable because I was trying to figure out where my locker was lol. Anyways I figured it out and my friends were inside the arcade room and played on a claw machine. The claw machine had a bunch of plushie toys in it. She kept winning and getting a bunch of them so we were cheering her on. When I opened the bottom to retrieve the plushies, there was a newspaper in it. Couldn’t really read it but it had a picture of a bigger white guy on it. Anyways I ended up teleporting in front of that guys house. Thats a whole different dream, but i ended up waking up. I’ve heard of mall world but never dreamed of it. Is this that?
